speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: In recent years, we have enhanced our subsidies for drugs and outpatient care, as well as introduced new MediSave coverage for outpatient scans, and flexible MediSave use for those aged 65 and above.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The introduction of MediShield Life in November 2015 also provided additional support for large hospital bills for all Singaporeans.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: I have a resident who is 77 years old.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: He has used up the $600 which is the cap for computed tomography (CT) scan for the abdomen, pelvis and bone.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Now, he needs $1,000 for prostate magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: The second question is that for those who are aged 65, can we revise the cap, especially for those who have a bigger sum in their MediSave?

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: The best way to deal with such cases would be for the Member to write in to MOH and we will take a look on a case-by-case basis at the circumstances of the situation that her resident is facing.
